stages.name: refine
evidence: Reviewed #230, Epic #224, the accepted #228 read-only proof contract and plan, the merged #229 OAuth/OIDC boundary, current MCP composition, and the existing Family/Calendar query handlers.

Confirmed the release scope is limited to authorized read-only agenda and household-member workflows over the protected MCP endpoint; no write tools, persistence access, or unsupported client guarantees are included.

Confirmed pending tasks remain deferred because no complete Tasks-owned read query exists, and member-specific agenda remains excluded until the existing member/family authorization gap is resolved and tested.

All applicable Definition of Ready dimensions are present in the issue: actor, dependencies, acceptance criteria, scope/exclusions, product rules, affected behavior, quality/security expectations, existing decisions, and risks. Issue transitioned from status:backlog to status:ready.

stages.name: propose
evidence: Draft PR #271 opened for the documentation-only plan and production contract: https://github.com/juangcarmona/domusmind/pull/271.

Independent proposal review at exact head 19bb083 requested four bounded corrections: separate capability release gating, per-tool audit attribution, explicit UTC reminder semantics, and SDK binding-error contract distinction.

Correction round 1 applied all four findings at dbec35e; the corrected plan keeps the catalog default-off, uses fixed allowlisted capability names, documents UTC reminder boundaries, and distinguishes binding failures from post-binding structured errors.

Independent proposal review round 2 approved exact corrected plan head dbec35e. The reviewer explicitly confirmed this approves the design only; implementation and production enablement remain separate gates.

stages.name: implement
evidence: Added the default-off HouseholdReadOnly capability gate, trusted request identity accessor, and two production read-only MCP tools: agenda_get and household_members_list.

Tools dispatch the existing GetFamilyTimelineQuery and GetFamilyMembersQuery, project minimal allowlisted output, reject identity selectors, map safe structured errors, preserve cancellation, and emit fixed per-tool audit attribution without raw arguments or content.

Added production-path synthetic application-query tests, protected OAuth release-catalog coverage, and a custom official .NET MCP client journey over loopback Kestrel HTTPS with protected-resource metadata discovery, PKCE, token exchange, tool discovery, and Streamable HTTP.

Full backend build passed; 881 backend tests passed with the repository's 3 expected PostgreSQL skips. Web lint/test/build, public-site build, markdown validation, and git diff checks passed. Existing dependency advisories and web lint warnings remain documented inherited findings.

Correction round fixed culture-dependent production date projection, moved the proof assertions onto production tool registration, added real application query handlers and fixtures to the HTTPS OAuth journey, and added cancellation/audit/no-write evidence.
Implementation correction commit: 8d26128; branch pushed to the Draft PR #271 head.

findings: Separate OAuth setup from the default-off production capability release gate.
Add capability-level audit attribution for the two tools and HTTP-200 tool errors.
Define date-window timezone semantics and test UTC reminder boundaries.
Distinguish SDK argument-binding failures from post-binding structured tool errors.

findings: Production date projection was culture-dependent; use invariant Gregorian formatting and test a non-Gregorian culture.
The HTTPS journey did not prove both production tools through real application handlers and fixtures, nor disabled/removed membership denial.
Most behavior evidence exercised proof-only tools rather than the production registration path.
